plugins.Author: Ice
plugins.Name: Gather & Chill
plugins.Punchline: The gathering companion that we all needed.
plugins.Description: A gathering plugin that will help you with your gathering needs. Between gathering items for you, or self applying buffs to make the task of gathering monotonous.
plugins.Changelog:
- IPC Changes  
- Fixed overlay not showing item progress  
- HOPEFULLY fixed the items not gathering after the first time? (No more rebooting... plz hopefully)  
- Overlay now has a little bar to show you what it's waiting on with the gp (if you're waiting for timed nodes for example and don't want to interact below a certain threshold)  
- Gather mode no longer counts down to 0 (it was causing some issues tbf, and now just locks in your initial inventory count)  
- If return set to none, it should no longer infinite loop itself and expect something like a disappointed mom  
- Overlay will now auto-open/close upon start/stop respectively when starting/stopping so you all can stop/worrying/bout/it/ugh

plugins.Author: Ice
plugins.Name: Chilled Leves
plugins.Punchline: I heard you like your leves on the rocks.
plugins.Description: The leve plugin that nobody wanted to make. Will display what leves you need to complete, as well as help automate them for your heart desires (not required though)
plugins.Changelog:
- If you're < 7 yalms away from the npc you're interacting with, it should continue on like normal (this is mainly a fix for the specific fisher leve vendor that everyone uses)
	- Speaking of them, adjusted the turnin point to be a bit more sane to allow for the above to work ^

### Gathering Playlist
- Changed all the checkboxes to buttons
	- It looks better
	- Fight me
	- I'm sick, you'll probably win
- Re-added the "repeat last leve" per a nicer's user request and not the snot nose one who decided to be rude and not even ask the time of day
- Fixed an issue where it was **still** sticking leves down, even though it shouldn't of to begin with *sigh*
- Re-added the export to TC button (it was kinda forgotten ngl), and fixed it to properly export the list instead of just grabbing *-everything-*

### ARR/HW Grind
- Renamed to gathering grind
	- Why? Because it's literally only gatherers. And also it supports but isn't required for lv. 70+ now
- Reworked the leve selection popup to allow for searching names, and sorting each job by lv. 
- Also, when you've completed every leve for that vendor, you'll get a nice little checkmark with it
- Stb+ leves aren't *-required-* for this, but since I was already doing it, figured i'd alteast give ya the option for it...

### Ui Changes
- Compact sidebar actually does something instead of being a sudo button
- Sidebar now has tooltips above it. So maybe people will read (they won't)

### Misc
- I probably forgot something. I'm unsure what it is...

plugins.Author: Ice
plugins.Name: Ice's Cosmic Exploration (ICE)
plugins.Punchline: Welcome to, the dark side of, the MOOOON
plugins.Description:
The one-stop shop to your cosmic exploration needs! This plugin is meant to be a collective source of being able to grind out your gather and crafter relics, while also being able to help grind out the score to 500k on each class for that sleek black mech that you want ~.

- Has the ability to re-roll missions for you until you get the desired one that you want to farm
- Crafters can be fully automated with support of artisan. 
- Fisher can also be fully automated with the support of AutoHook and Navmesh
- Botanist/Miner only need Navmesh, thanks to having gathering built in directly to the plugin <3. 
- Setup what items you want to buy from the shop for cosmocredits, or spend your planetary tokens on the cosmowheel of fortune!
plugins.Changelog: - Cosmic will only enable autohook if it needs to start a fishing mission, will not try and disable it.
